plugins.name: bug-hunt
plugins.description: Adversarial, expert-level bug hunt for any application — recon, static, runtime, and adversarial probes driven by a researched bug taxonomy.

plugins.name: deai
plugins.description: Rewrite AI-generated text so it reads as genuinely human-written in a professional register — strip LLM signatures while preserving meaning, never fabricating.

plugins.name: chaos
plugins.description: API-focused chaos engineering — hypothesis-driven fault injection via a shipped zero-dependency fault proxy + black-box verification of the resilience-mechanism fingerprint (breaker/retry/fallback/shed), strict blast-radius + auto-disarm safety, regression test per weakness.

plugins.name: pentest
plugins.description: Authorized penetration test — full engagement lifecycle (rules-of-engagement gate → recon → enumeration → threat model/attack tree → exploitation → vulnerability chaining → post-exploitation → professional report) aligned to PTES, NIST SP 800-115, OWASP WSTG/ASVS/API Top 10, and MITRE ATT&CK. Adversary emulation toward a crown-jewel objective with minimum-necessary non-destructive proof, CVSS scoring, and a retest check per finding. Authorization is a hard first gate.

plugins.name: llm-eval
plugins.description: Build and run a rigorous evaluation of any LLM app/agent — and make the eval itself trustworthy. Deterministic-first metrics, judges validated against human labels (Cohen's κ) before trusted, claim-decomposition faithfulness/hallucination detection, judge-bias controls (position/verbosity/self-preference), and statistical honesty (paired-difference + confidence intervals + fixed temperature — never a win on noise). Ships a zero-dependency eval harness; no promptfoo/DeepEval/RAGAS needed.

plugins.name: ui-verify
plugins.description: Prove a deployed web UI actually WORKS, not just loads — 'deployed ≠ working'. Asserts a verification ladder (loads → renders real content → wired to backend → functional end-to-end): semantic content oracles, console + network fail-gates (incl. wrong-endpoint detection), SSE streaming verification, visual baseline diff, axe a11y — with deterministic waits + retry-quorum so a pass means a pass, and a structured evidence report. Ships a zero-dependency CDP driver (Node 22 + Chrome, no npm/Playwright); also uses the chrome-devtools MCP or Playwright when present.

plugins.name: debug
plugins.description: Find the ROOT CAUSE of a failure by disciplined hypothesis-and-falsification with shipped instrumentation — never fix before you understand. Distributed-systems-aware (containers/LB/cross-VCN/IAM eventual-consistency/shared resources): reproduce → observe → hypothesize → falsify by toggling → bisect → confirm → prove the fix → regression-guard, with a Confirmed-vs-Suspected gate (correlation ≠ cause) and a localization decision tree. Ships a zero-dependency boundary tracer (DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP/auth/content probes + working-vs-failing differential).
